THE IDEA BEHIND MORETIME

A bill is paperwork.
You’re a person.

MoreTime is being built to uncover protections and assistance you may qualify for, starting with your notice, location, and circumstances.

01

Start with the notice.

A shutoff warning, an overdue bill, or a disputed charge. Identify the sender, service, deadlines, and what the notice actually says.

02

Find the rules that matter.

Check local utility protections, assistance programs, and provider rules against your situation. See the source behind each option.

03

Turn an option into action.

Prepare a protection request, a dispute, or an assistance application. Track replies and deadlines until the outcome is confirmed.

You don’t need all the answers.
Just somewhere to start.
